headline: Lighter freezes withdrawals after a $10.4M drain

scenes.vo: Crypto exchange Lighter just froze withdrawals after about ten million dollars was drained. Here's what changed.
On Monday morning, about ten point four million dollars in USDC left Lighter and was swapped into ether. Lighter blames a leaked access key on one trader's account.
Here's why traders are watching it. Lighter says its smart contracts were not hit, and it aims to reopen withdrawals by the end of the day.
The catch. On-chain sleuths claim a second account was hit, about fifteen million dollars total. Lighter hasn't confirmed a number.
Here's what happens next. Watch whether withdrawals reopen today, and whether Lighter publishes a full incident report.
